svg.text: Layer 1 - electronics tray
front of car ->
1. velcro under the bank (~4 mm) | held by: adhesive both sides |
ports:
2. velcro under the holder (~4 mm) | held by: adhesive both sides |
ports:
3. battery bank (Pi power) | held by: velcro + 14 mm bank fence,
open at the rear | ports: -x: USB-C + USB-A (20 / 45 mm from the
left)
4. 2S holder + 2x Samsung 25R | held by: velcro + 14 mm holder fence
| ports: leads red / black + MB wire; exit end not measured
5. USB-C 2S charger (Adeept p0374) | held by: zip ties at x 64 and
92 | ports: pads BAT, GND, GND, VIN; USB-C side not stated
6. 2S BMS (ACEIRMC B08HLQQCQJ) | held by: double-sided tape | ports:
pads B+ B- MB P+ P-
7. inline fuse holder, 3 A ATO (50 x 34.25 x 12, lying flat) | held
by: on top of the bank; tape or ride under a bank tie | ports: in
the CELL+ wire, before the BMS
8. XT30 pair, mated (25 x 10.5 x 5.3) | held by: zip tie at x 120 |
ports: BMS P+ / P- side; car side to the rocker
Layer 2 - electronics deck
front of car ->
1. velcro under the Pi case (~4 mm) | held by: adhesive both sides |
ports:
2. Raspberry Pi 5 in Vilros case | held by: velcro + 4 corner
brackets (10 mm), pocket +0.25 per side | ports: +x: camera +
USB-C power; -x: 2x USB-A + LAN
3. Arduino Uno R3 + proto shield (TB6612, caps, divider) | held by:
4 standoffs + pegs | ports: -y: USB-B (overhangs 7.3) + DC jack
(4.1); jack positions NOT measured
4. USB-B plug clearance (16 x 30 x 13 allowance, plug NOT measured)
| held by: hangs from the Uno jack | ports: -y: to the Pi
5. LM2596 buck, 5.00 V (display) | held by: 4 standoffs + pegs |
ports: display up; trim pot locked
6. rocker switch (20 mm round) | held by: snap-in 20 mm hole |
ports: body hangs below the tab; depth NOT measured
